title: A curvilinear model grid

dataset.name: CMIP6 GFDL-ESM4 historical Omon tos, 50 km tripolar grid with 2D lon/lat (Pangeo Google Cloud bucket)

gap: Both sides draw a tripolar grid, by different routes. gridlook places each cell on the sphere from its 2D lon/lat; rangefinder rasterises the cells into an affine view grid and warps that. ortho-cog-viewer and rwarp still need an affine source and cannot show this at all.
bridge: Lift rangefinder's curvilinear.js (corners from geoloc arrays, cell rasterisation) into the shared reads module so ortho-cog-viewer and rwarp get it for free; the cell-mesh renderer (anglr-style) stays the better long-term target for the warp shells.
todo: confirm the curvilinear detection fires in the vendored gridlook build (it is in their shipped catalog tagged curvilinear)

Australian data: rangefinder's picker has BRAN2023 (CSIRO Bluelink) as Kerchunk Parquet over NCI THREDDS; that is warp-side only, since gridlook does not read Kerchunk Parquet. A plain Zarr or Icechunk copy of one BRAN slice would let both sides draw it
